svg.title: Figure S7 preview: BankSim descriptive time structure
svg.desc: Fifty-four simulation steps. Transaction and fraud counts and paired five-seed mean capture differences from frozen whole-window top-3% selections. No step-wise reranking or new intervals.
svg.text: Whole-window top-3% selections attributed to steps; no step-wise reranking.
H0 = B0H - B0; H1 = B1H - B1. Contribution curves show five-seed mean differences.
